name: Alpinolino
kurzbeschreibung: The **interactive experience museum** for kids all about **Alpen**, nature, and technology—featuring a climbing wall and hands-on experiment stations.
beschreibung: Alpinolino – The Alpinolino is a cultural highlight in **Imst** and attracts visitors from around the world. This interactive experience museum for children focuses on the themes of the Alps, nature, and technology, featuring a climbing wall and hands-on experiment stations. The diverse event program, including concerts, readings, and workshops, makes every visit unique. Especially memorable are the atmospheric evening tours and themed special exhibitions. Located right in the heart of **Imst**, the Alpinolino is easily accessible on foot or by public transport. Its central location makes it the perfect starting point for a cultural stroll through the city. Families with children will also find plenty to discover and enjoy here. Allow plenty of time—the Alpinolino will captivate you with its beauty and variety.
